name: depscan-vscode
description: Ranks the vulnerable dependencies in your workspace by risk and trust, offline. Read-only: it never changes your dependency files.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No scan yet.
[Scan workspace](command:depscan.scan)
Reads requirements.txt, package.json, lock files and go.mod. Nothing is installed or changed.
No findings does not prove a project is secure.

depscan.repoPath.markdownDescription: Folder of the depscan project (the one that contains the `depscan` package and `data/`). Empty: the folder above this extension, if it is the depscan repo.

depscan.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python that has depscan's requirements installed. Empty: the repo's `.venv`, else `python`.

depscan.dataDir.markdownDescription: Folder of cached data snapshots. Empty: `data/` inside the depscan repo.

depscan.offline.markdownDescription: Never use the network (version ranges are then tested at their lowest allowed version).

depscan.reviewer.markdownDescription: Name recorded with review decisions. Typed in, not authenticated. Asked once if empty.

depscan.scanOnSave.markdownDescription: Re-scan when a dependency file is saved.

depscan.consoleUrl.markdownDescription: Where `depscan: Open the web console` goes. Start it with `python -m depscan serve`.
